column1: # entities_total 9271 -> 7174 (-22.6%) is NOT a regression. Bisected to
# bfdc3d3f (2026-08-23), which replaced "spawn every expanded armor candidate"
# with biped-slot occupancy resolution: only the items that actually win a slot
# now get a mesh. Pre-fix, VFSAtomicWranglerGambler spawned 29 interpenetrating
# armor meshes from 9 inventory entries; it now spawns 2. Across the cell,
# armor meshes 123 -> 24, skinned meshes 677 -> 206, unique meshes 1265 -> 772.
# Measured directly across the commit boundary:
# The 2026-08-06 baseline captured the pre-fix over-equip and baked it in, so
# the OLD numbers were the wrong ones. NPC count (19) and cell-load entities
# (~2001) are unchanged across the boundary — nothing failed to spawn.
# CAVEAT — bench_draws_batches 109 is a KNOWN-REGRESSED value carried forward
# under #3005, not an endorsement. It is NOT caused by the armor fix: the
# parent commit already read 109. Bisected timeline of this cell's draw split:
#   c0f3cda3 2026-08-07  2553/ 89b/25c   <- the value this baseline replaced
# Merge efficiency fell from 28.7 to 19.4 cmds/batch. Re-tighten this row when
# #3005 lands; until then a batch gate against 89 would be permanently red and
# would mask any NEW batching regression, which is why it is refreshed here.
# entities=7180, draws=2110/109b/26c — i.e. byte-identical to the rows below,
# so this scene is back inside the x1.1 contract on all three draw metrics.
# The cause of the 2026-08-16 finding is the depth-primary alpha-over ordering
# the deliberate, required cost of the #1804/#2237 compositing fix, not a
# batching defect. The sibling fo3 baseline was refreshed in the same commit
# with the same justification; it keeps a residual batch-split regression
# (EXACT PASS per the RT-4 evidence table); all_slots is a new,
# stays 0 and skin_pool_max stays 1364 on all five games — no pressure on
# the #1284 cap, continuing the documented benign-creep line. Regenerated;
# now advisory, not a hard gate (see skin_pool_max/overflow_attempts).
# band). bench_draws_cmds is unchanged, so this is body-count creep, not
# render-load growth — the same benign pattern as the #1705/RT-3 note
# #3556/RT-10 — light_count_directional was derived from block presence
# (always 1, could never fail — #3424); the real per-emitter dump measures
# bench_fps_* is advisory only under xvfb (RT-2 / #1701) — never gate on it.
# entities_total: +/-2% tolerance metric, not exact (#1705 / RT-3).
